title: Nu Html Checker
supports: HTML validation; conformance errors; markup diagnostics
explanation: Checks HTML source or a public page for conformance problems and produces diagnostics pointing to markup that needs review. Validation is a useful quality check, but passing it does not prove that a page is accessible, secure, or usable.
example: Validate a page after creating the initial structure and again after larger changes. Fix the first useful structural error, re-run the checker, then test keyboard behavior and assistive-technology output separately.
